answer: It's important to prioritize your own well-being and consider various options. Reflect on the reasons why you feel overwhelmed; it could be due to communication issues, lack of support, or ignoring personal needs. Consider talking to a therapist or counselor for guidance and support. If you decide to separate, ensure you have a solid plan in place and seek support from friends, family, or professional services. Your safety and that of any children involved are essential, so consider a safe place to stay if you feel threatened.
